title: 'Session 11 — Describe your dataset'
subtitle: 'Day 2 · 60 minutes'
---

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
- **Reading:** None assigned — you work from your own dataset
- **Material:** Own dataset
- **Output:** Draft dataset description
:::

## In class

Students work with their own dataset. They first describe it formally: observations, variables, variable types, population or scope, and useful summaries. They then describe its setting: origin, purpose, producers, collection process, categories, transformations, missing context, limits, and possible harms.

Use the Data Setting Checklist from [Session 4](04-what-does-local-mean.qmd). Use the [statistics cheat sheet](../cheat-sheet.qmd) for the formal description.

## Output

A draft of the final assignment. The [assignments](../assignments.qmd) page lists the eight questions that the final text must answer.
